name: Akila Dananjaya
profileSummary: Mahamarakkala Kurukulasooriya Patabendige Akila Dananjaya Perera, popularly known as Akila Dananjaya, is a professional Sri Lankan cricketer, who played all forms of the game for the national team. In March 2021, he became the first bowler to take hat-trick and be hit for the maximum of six sixes in an over in the same match, by Kieron Pollard against West Indies.
